name.text: Calculating the area of an irregular piece of land

questiontext.text:
A surveyor recorded the following measurements for an irregular piece of land AEDF using a baseline AD. Vertices E and F are on opposite sides of the baseline.

  • Baseline segments: AB = {@d1@} m, BC = {@d2@} m, and CD = {@d3@} m.
  • Left Offset: BE = {@hL@} m (perpendicular to AD at B).
  • Right Offset: CF = {@hR@} m (perpendicular to AD at C).
[[jsxgraph width="400px" height="500px"]] var d1 = {#d1#}; var d2 = {#d2#}; var d3 = {#d3#}; var hL = {#hL#}; var hR = {#hR#}; var AD = d1 + d2 + d3; // Dynamic Bounding Box ensuring a perfect fit var totalW = hL + hR; var spanY = AD * 1.25; var ratio = 400 / 500; var spanX = spanY * ratio; if (totalW * 1.25 > spanX) { spanX = totalW * 1.25; spanY = spanX / ratio; } var midX = (hR - hL) / 2; var midY = AD / 2; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, { boundingbox: [midX - spanX/2, midY + spanY/2, midX + spanX/2, midY - spanY/2], axis: false, showCopyright: false, keepAspectRatio: true, showNavigation: false }); // Vertical Baseline AD var A = board.create('point', [0, 0], {name: 'A', fixed: true, color: 'black'}); var B = board.create('point', [0, d1], {name: 'B', fixed: true, color: 'black'}); var C = board.create('point', [0, d1+d2], {name: 'C', fixed: true, color: 'black'}); var D = board.create('point', [0, AD], {name: 'D', fixed: true, color: 'black'}); // Offsets var E = board.create('point', [-hL, d1], {name: 'E', color: '#1565c0'}); var F = board.create('point', [hR, d1+d2], {name: 'F', color: '#d32f2f'}); // Polygon AEDF board.create('polygon', [A, E, D, F], {fillColor: '#fdf2e9', borders: {strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: '#212121'}}); // Construction Lines board.create('segment', [A, D], {dash: 1, strokeColor: '#757575'}); board.create('segment', [B, E], {dash: 2, strokeColor: '#1976d2'}); board.create('segment', [C, F], {dash: 2, strokeColor: '#c62828'}); // Right angle markers var rad = spanY * 0.04; board.create('angle', [E, B, A], {type: 'square', radius: rad, strokeColor: '#1976d2', name: ''}); board.create('angle', [F, C, D], {type: 'square', radius: rad, strokeColor: '#c62828', name: ''}); // Dynamic Labels with Pixel Gaps var gapX = spanX * 0.02; var gapY = spanY * 0.02; // Baseline segment labels board.create('text', [gapX, d1/2, d1 + " m"], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 13, strokeColor: '#757575'}); board.create('text', [gapX, d1 + d2/2, d2 + " m"], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 13, strokeColor: '#757575'}); board.create('text', [gapX, d1 + d2 + d3/2, d3 + " m"], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 13, strokeColor: '#757575'}); // Offset labels board.create('text', [-hL/2, d1 + gapY, hL + " m"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'bottom', fontSize: 14, strokeColor: '#1976d2'}); board.create('text', [hR/2, d1+d2 + gapY, hR + " m"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'bottom', fontSize: 14, strokeColor: '#c62828'}); [[/jsxgraph]]

Calculate the total area of the land AEDF.

Area = [[input:ans1]] \(\text{m}^2\) [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

To calculate the total area, we find the area of the large triangles on the left and right sides of the baseline AD separately.

First, find the total length of the baseline AD:

\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Base AD} &= {@d1@} + {@d2@} + {@d3@} \\ &= {@AD@} \text{ m} \end{aligned} \]

1. Area of Left Side (Triangle AED)

The vertex E forms one large triangle with base AD.

\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Area (Left)} &= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{Base (AD)} \times \text{Height (BE)} \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \times {@AD@} \times {@hL@} \\ &= {@area_left@} \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned} \]

2. Area of Right Side (Triangle AFD)

The vertex F forms one large triangle with base AD.

\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Area (Right)} &= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{Base (AD)} \times \text{Height (CF)} \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \times {@AD@} \times {@hR@} \\ &= {@area_right@} \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned} \]

3. Total Area

\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Total Area} &= \text{Area (Left)} + \text{Area (Right)} \\ &= {@area_left@} + {@area_right@} \\ &= {@ta@} \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned} \]

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text: You forgot the \(\frac{1}{2}\) factor. The formula for the area of a triangle is \(\frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}\).
